svg.title: ACT training step
svg.desc: A batch of recorded images, joint states and 100-step action chunks. A CVAE encoder reads the true actions and gives the mean and variance of a 32-dimensional style latent; z is sampled with the reparameterization trick and becomes the first token of the policy. The loss is the masked L1 error of the predicted chunk plus ten times the KL divergence; AdamW updates all weights at a constant learning rate.
svg.text: ACT learns to rebuild the recorded chunk.

g.text: one of 32 dimensions · at inference z = 0
z = μ + σ ⊙ ε, ε ~ N(0, I)
the network from the Inference tab
+ KL(q ‖ N(0, I)) summed over 32 dims

svg.text: source · lerobot train, ACT preset · 100,000 steps · click a block or use the arrow keys
